extension.summary: Share Stream Cinema preferences and viewing history through private Kra storage.
extension.description: Synchronize watched states, resume positions, Last seen, interface sounds, selected addon preferences and Amber appearance. Keep credentials, hardware settings and navigation local. Network operations run in the background.
extension.news: 0.1.2: Share Kodi interface sound mode and volume while keeping audio hardware local. Restore existing cloud values when an upgrade adds new preferences.
